Home / People / Luke Bridgeman Portfolio Manager, Senior Partner Luke Bridgeman University of Oxford, MA Member of the Management Committee Having founded Hosking Partners alongside Jeremy and colleagues in 2013, Luke is Senior Partner and Portfolio Manager and sits on the firm’s Management Committee. Luke was previously senior analyst and head of special situations at Marathon Asset Management, where he worked as a member of the global equity team for three years. Previously Luke set up and ran private equity firm Dawnay Day Principal Finance before moving to Grove International Partners. Luke spent the first eight years of his career at Morgan Grenfell, mostly in Morgan Grenfell Private Equity. He has featured on the Merryn Talks Money podcast and has joined the Business Breakdowns podcast multiple times to discuss our portfolio holdings. Selected Perspectives View all → Hosking Post 9
